purpose: Offline racing-line expert, compared against the previously tuned centerline expert. No neural training, IL label collection or real-vehicle control.

method.description: Normal-offset closed-path local curvature optimization followed by a speed-envelope lap-time objective; clearance-checked and steering-checked candidates ranked by estimated lap time.

generation_metadata.description: Build offline racing-line files; simulator rollouts must verify their quality.

experiment_config.description: Small-map Pure Pursuit expert, selected on train maps only. Simulation assumptions; not measured real-vehicle limits.

assumptions.note: ERPM response cannot identify tire slip, ground speed or battery charge limits.

generation_metadata.method: Bounded local minimum-curvature optimization followed by a speed-envelope lap-time objective; clearance-checked blends ranked by estimated time. Not a global optimum.

tests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_racing_line.py tests/test_expert.py tests/test_small_map_expert.py tests/test_sim6mps.py -q

selection_scope: Optimizer design chosen using 8 training maps and synthetic unit tests. Same frozen procedure then optimized each of 580 known map geometries; val rollouts were not used to tune parameters. Val expert construction is not an unseen-map neural-policy test.
limitations: Finite simulator validation, not a global lap-time optimum or a guarantee for every initial state.
Static clearance uses dense path samples and 15 oriented footprint samples; it is not a continuous geometric proof or measured dynamic real-car wall clearance.
Simulator friction, steering and longitudinal response are assumptions; electrical faults and battery regeneration limits are not modeled.
Expert requires full map and pose. The current deployed LiDAR neural model and its weights are unchanged.
No imitation dataset was collected. Future collection must use full-progress completion, including maps where legacy finish-zone termination fires early.
